Demo
We'll start by building the following form. It has a simple text input and a textarea. On submit, we'll validate the form data and display any errors.
Note: For the purpose of this demo, we have intentionally disabled browser
validation to show how schema validation and form errors work in TanStack
Form. It is recommended to add basic browser validation in your production
code.

Approach
This form leverages TanStack Form for powerful, headless form handling. We'll build our form using the \<Field /> component, which gives you complete flexibility over the markup and styling.

Uses TanStack Form's useForm hook for form state management.
form.Field component with render prop pattern for controlled inputs.
\<Field /> components for building accessible forms.
Client-side validation using Zod.
Real-time validation feedback.

Form
Create a schema
We'll start by defining the shape of our form using a Zod schema.
Note: This example uses zod v3 for schema validation. TanStack Form
integrates seamlessly with Zod and other Standard Schema validation libraries
through its validators API.
form.tsxCopyimport \* as z from "zod"

const formSchema = z.object({
title: z
.string()
.min(5, "Bug title must be at least 5 characters.")
.max(32, "Bug title must be at most 32 characters."),
description: z
.string()
.min(20, "Description must be at least 20 characters.")
.max(100, "Description must be at most 100 characters."),
})
Setup the form
Use the useForm hook from TanStack Form to create your form instance with Zod validation.
form.tsxCopyimport { useForm } from "@tanstack/react-form"
import { toast } from "sonner"
import \* as z from "zod"

const formSchema = z.object({
// ...
})

export function BugReportForm() {
const form = useForm({
defaultValues: {
title: "",
description: "",
},
validators: {
onSubmit: formSchema,
},
onSubmit: async ({ value }) => {
toast.success("Form submitted successfully")
},
})

return (
\<form
onSubmit={(e) => {
e.preventDefault()
form.handleSubmit()
}}
\>
{/\* ... \*/}
\</form>
)
}
We are using onSubmit to validate the form data here. TanStack Form supports other validation modes, which you can read about in the documentation.
Build the form
We can now build the form using the form.Field component from TanStack Form and the \<Field /> component.

import \* as React from "react"
import { useForm } from "@tanstack/react-form"
import { toast } from "sonner"
import \* as z from "zod"

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import {

InputGroup,

InputGroupText,
InputGroupTextarea,
} from "@/components/ui/input-group"

const formSchema = z.object({
title: z
.string()
.min(5, "Bug title must be at least 5 characters.")
.max(32, "Bug title must be at most 32 characters."),
description: z
.string()
.min(20, "Description must be at least 20 characters.")
.max(100, "Description must be at most 100 characters."),
})

export function BugReportForm() {
const form = useForm({
defaultValues: {
title: "",
description: "",
},
validators: {
onSubmit: formSchema,
},
onSubmit: async ({ value }) => {
toast("You submitted the following values:", {
description: (
\<pre className="mt-2 w-\[320px] overflow-x-auto rounded-md bg-code p-4 text-code-foreground">
\<code>{JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)}\</code>
\</pre>
),
position: "bottom-right",
classNames: {
content: "flex flex-col gap-2",
},
style: {
"--border-radius": "calc(var(--radius)  + 4px)",
} as React.CSSProperties,
})
},
})

return (
\<Card className="w-full sm:max-w-md">
\<CardHeader>
\<CardTitle>Bug Report\</CardTitle>
\<CardDescription>
Help us improve by reporting bugs you encounter.
\</CardDescription>
\</CardHeader>
\<CardContent>
\<form
id="bug-report-form"
onSubmit={(e) => {
e.preventDefault()
form.handleSubmit()
}}
\>
\<FieldGroup>
\<form.Field
name="title"
children={(field) => {
const isInvalid =
field.state.meta.isTouched && !field.state.meta.isValid
return (
\<Field data-invalid={isInvalid}>
\<FieldLabel htmlFor={field.name}>Bug Title\</FieldLabel>
\<Input
id={field.name}
name={field.name}
value={field.state.value}
onBlur={field.handleBlur}
onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
aria-invalid={isInvalid}
placeholder="Login button not working on mobile"
autoComplete="off"
/>
{isInvalid && (
\<FieldError errors={field.state.meta.errors} />
)}
\</Field>
)
}}
/>
\<form.Field
name="description"
children={(field) => {
const isInvalid =
field.state.meta.isTouched && !field.state.meta.isValid
return (
\<Field data-invalid={isInvalid}>
\<FieldLabel htmlFor={field.name}>Description\</FieldLabel>
\<InputGroup>
\<InputGroupTextarea
id={field.name}
name={field.name}
value={field.state.value}
onBlur={field.handleBlur}
onChange={(e) => field.handleChange(e.target.value)}
placeholder="I'm having an issue with the login button on mobile."
rows={6}
className="min-h-24 resize-none"
aria-invalid={isInvalid}
/>
\<InputGroupAddon align="block-end">
\<InputGroupText className="tabular-nums">
{field.state.value.length}/100 characters
\</InputGroupText>
\</InputGroupAddon>
\</InputGroup>
\<FieldDescription>
Include steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and what
actually happened.
\</FieldDescription>
{isInvalid && (
\<FieldError errors={field.state.meta.errors} />
)}
\</Field>
)
}}
/>
\</FieldGroup>
\</form>
\</CardContent>
\<CardFooter>
\<Field orientation="horizontal">
\<Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => form.reset()}>
Reset
\</Button>
\<Button type="submit" form="bug-report-form">
Submit
\</Button>
\</Field>
\</CardFooter>
\</Card>

Done
That's it. You now have a fully accessible form with client-side validation.
When you submit the form, the onSubmit function will be called with the validated form data. If the form data is invalid, TanStack Form will display the errors next to each field.
Validation
Client-side Validation
TanStack Form validates your form data using the Zod schema. Validation happens in real-time as the user types.
form.tsxCopyimport { useForm } from "@tanstack/react-form"

const formSchema = z.object({
// ...
})

export function BugReportForm() {
const form = useForm({
defaultValues: {
title: "",
description: "",
},
validators: {
onSubmit: formSchema,
},
onSubmit: async ({ value }) => {
console.log(value)
},
})

return \<form onSubmit={/\* ... */}>{/* ... \*/}\</form>
}
Validation Modes
TanStack Form supports different validation strategies through the validators option:
ModeDescription"onChange"Validation triggers on every change."onBlur"Validation triggers on blur."onSubmit"Validation triggers on submit.
form.tsxCopyconst form = useForm({
defaultValues: {
title: "",
description: "",
},
validators: {
onSubmit: formSchema,
onChange: formSchema,
onBlur: formSchema,
},
})
Displaying Errors
Display errors next to the field using \<FieldError />. For styling and accessibility:

Add the data-invalid prop to the \<Field /> component.
Add the aria-invalid prop to the form control such as \<Input />, \<SelectTrigger />, \<Checkbox />, etc.

form.tsxCopy\<form.Field
name="email"
children={(field) => {
const isInvalid = field.state.meta.isTouched && !field.state.meta.isValid

```
      id={field.name}

      onBlur={field.handleBlur}

      type=&quot;email&quot;
      aria-invalid={isInvalid}
    /&gt;
    {isInvalid &amp;&amp; &lt;FieldError errors={field.state.meta.errors} /&gt;}
  &lt;/Field&gt;
)
```

}}

Working with Different Field Types
Input

For input fields, use field.state.value and field.handleChange on the \<Input /> component.
To show errors, add the aria-invalid prop to the \<Input /> component and the data-invalid prop to the \<Field /> component.

Array Fields
TanStack Form provides powerful array field management with mode="array". This allows you to dynamically add, remove, and update array items with full validation support.
Contact EmailsManage your contact email addresses.Email AddressesAdd up to 5 email addresses where we can contact you.Add Email AddressResetSaveCopy"use client"

import \* as React from "react"View Code
This example demonstrates managing multiple email addresses with array fields. Users can add up to 5 email addresses, remove individual addresses, and each address is validated independently.
Array Field Structure
Use mode="array" on the parent field to enable array field management.
form.tsxCopy\<form.Field
name="emails"
mode="array"
children={(field) => {
return (
\<FieldSet>
\<FieldLegend variant="label">Email Addresses\</FieldLegend>
\<FieldDescription>
Add up to 5 email addresses where we can contact you.
\</FieldDescription>
\<FieldGroup>
{field.state.value.map((\_, index) => (
// Nested field for each array item
))}
\</FieldGroup>
\</FieldSet>
)
}}
/>
Nested Fields
Access individual array items using bracket notation: fieldName\[index].propertyName. This example uses InputGroup to display the remove button inline with the input.
form.tsxCopy\<form.Field
name={`emails[${</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8;--shiki-light:#1F2328">index</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF;--shiki-light:#0A3069">}].address`}
children={(subField) => {
const isSubFieldInvalid =
subField.state.meta.isTouched && !subField.state.meta.isValid
return (
\<Field orientation="horizontal" data-invalid={isSubFieldInvalid}>
\<FieldContent>
\<InputGroup>
\<InputGroupInput
id={`form-tanstack-array-email-${</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8;--shiki-light:#1F2328">index</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF;--shiki-light:#0A3069">}`}
name={subField.name}
value={subField.state.value}
onBlur={subField.handleBlur}
onChange={(e) => subField.handleChange(e.target.value)}
aria-invalid={isSubFieldInvalid}
placeholder="name@example.com"
type="email"
/>
{field.state.value.length > 1 && (
\<InputGroupAddon align="inline-end">
\<InputGroupButton
type="button"
variant="ghost"
size="icon-xs"
onClick={() => field.removeValue(index)}
aria-label={`Remove email ${</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#E1E4E8;--shiki-light:#1F2328">index</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#F97583;--shiki-light:#CF222E"> +</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#79B8FF;--shiki-light:#0550AE"> 1</span><span style="--shiki-dark:#9ECBFF;--shiki-light:#0A3069">}`}
\>
\<XIcon />
\</InputGroupButton>
\</InputGroupAddon>
)}
\</InputGroup>
{isSubFieldInvalid && (
\<FieldError errors={subField.state.meta.errors} />
)}
\</FieldContent>
\</Field>
)
}}
/>
Adding Items
Use field.pushValue(item) to add items to an array field. You can disable the button when the array reaches its maximum length.
form.tsxCopy\<Button
type="button"
variant="outline"
size="sm"
onClick={() => field.pushValue({ address: "" })}
disabled={field.state.value.length >= 5}
\>
Add Email Address
\</Button>
Removing Items
Use field.removeValue(index) to remove items from an array field. You can conditionally show the remove button only when there's more than one item.
form.tsxCopy{
field.state.value.length > 1 && (

5be2.js?dpl=dpl\_2kbMdjqNFz7HjQh3uR8mnivDqPnA","/*next/static/chunks/f3450ebdda31f7f3.js?dpl=dpl\_2kbMdjqNFz7HjQh3uR8mnivDqPnA","/*next/static/chunks/03b69a6c75c59d66.js?dpl=dpl\_2kbMdjqNFz7HjQh3uR8mnivDqPnA","/*next/static/chunks/1d9132152bf118f6.js?dpl=dpl\_2kbMdjqNFz7HjQh3uR8mnivDqPnA"],"DocsCopyPage"]\n"])self.**next\_f.push(\[1,"42:T510b,"])self.**next\_f.push(\[1,"---\ntitle: TanStack Form\ndescription: Build forms in React using TanStack Form and Zod.\nlinks:\n  doc: https://tanstack.com/form\n---\n\nimport { InfoIcon } from "lucide-react"\n\nThis guide explores how to build forms using TanStack Form. You'll learn to create forms with the `\u003cField /\u003e` component, implement schema validation with Zod, handle errors, and ensure accessibility.\n\n## Demo\n\nWe'll start by building the following form. It has a simple text input and a textarea. On submit, we'll validate the form data and display any errors.\n\n\u003cCallout icon={\u003cInfoIcon /\u003e}\u003e\n  **Note:** For the purpose of this demo, we have intentionally disabled browser\n  validation to show how schema validation and form errors work in TanStack\n  Form. It is recommended to add basic browser validation in your production\n  code.\n\u003c/Callout\u003e\n\n\u003cComponentPreview\n  name="form-tanstack-demo"\n  className="sm:\[\u0026*.preview]:h-\[700px]"\n  chromeLessOnMobile\n/\u003e\n\n## Approach\n\nThis form leverages TanStack Form for powerful, headless form handling. We'll build our form using the `\u003cField /\u003e` component, which gives you **complete flexibility over the markup and styling**.\n\n- Uses TanStack Form's `useForm` hook for form state management.\n- `form.Field` component with render prop pattern for controlled inputs.\n- `\u003cField /\u003e` components for building accessible forms.\n- Client-side validation using Zod.\n- Real-time validation feedback.\n\n## Anatomy\n\nHere's a basic example of a form using TanStack Form with the `\u003cField /\u003e` component.\n\n`tsx showLineNumbers {15-31}\n\u003cform\n  onSubmit={(e) =\u003e {\n    e.preventDefault()\n    form.handleSubmit()\n  }}\n\u003e\n  \u003cFieldGroup\u003e\n    \u003cform.Field\n      name=\"title\"\n      children={(field) =\u003e {\n        const isInvalid =\n          field.state.meta.isTouched \u0026\u0026 !field.state.meta.isValid\n        return (\n          \u003cField data-invalid={isInvalid}\u003e\n            \u003cFieldLabel htmlFor={field.name}\u003eBug Title\u003c/FieldLabel\u003e\n            \u003cInput\n              id={field.name}\n              name={field.name}\n              value={field.state.value}\n              onBlur={field.handleBlur}\n              onChange={(e) =\u003e field.handleChange(e.target.value)}\n              aria-invalid={isInvalid}\n              placeholder=\"Login button not working on mobile\"\n              autoComplete=\"off\"\n            /\u003e\n            \u003cFieldDescription\u003e\n              Provide a concise title for your bug report.\n            \u003c/FieldDescription\u003e\n            {isInvalid \u0026\u0026 \u003cFieldError errors={field.state.meta.errors} /\u003e}\n          \u003c/Field\u003e\n        )\n      }}\n    /\u003e\n  \u003c/FieldGroup\u003e\n  \u003cButton type=\"submit\"\u003eSubmit\u003c/Button\u003e\n\u003c/form\u003e\n`\n\n## Form\n\n### Create a schema\n\nWe'll start by defining the shape of our form using a Zod schema.\n\n\u003cCallout icon={\u003cInfoIcon /\u003e}\u003e\n  **Note:** This example uses `zod v3` for schema validation. TanStack Form\n  integrates seamlessly with Zod and other Standard Schema validation libraries\n  through its validators API.\n\u003c/Callout\u003e\n\n`tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\"\nimport * as z from \"zod\"\n\nconst formSchema = z.object({\n  title: z\n    .string()\n    .min(5, \"Bug title must be at least 5 characters.\")\n    .max(32, \"Bug title must be at most 32 characters.\"),\n  description: z\n    .string()\n    .min(20, \"Description must be at least 20 characters.\")\n    .max(100, \"Description must be at most 100 characters.\"),\n})\n`\n\n### Setup the form\n\nUse the `useForm` hook from TanStack Form to create your form instance with Zod validation.\n\n`tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\" {10-21}\nimport { useForm } from \"@tanstack/react-form\"\nimport { toast } from \"sonner\"\nimport * as z from \"zod\"\n\nconst formSchema = z.object({\n  // ...\n})\n\nexport function BugReportForm() {\n  const form = useForm({\n    defaultValues: {\n      title: \"\",\n      description: \"\",\n    },\n    validators: {\n      onSubmit: formSchema,\n    },\n    onSubmit: async ({ value }) =\u003e {\n      toast.success(\"Form submitted successfully\")\n    },\n  })\n\n  return (\n    \u003cform\n      onSubmit={(e) =\u003e {\n        e.preventDefault()\n        form.handleSubmit()\n      }}\n    \u003e\n      {/* ... */}\n    \u003c/form\u003e\n  )\n}\n`\n\nWe are using `onSubmit` to validate the form data here. TanStack Form supports other validation modes, which you can read about in the [documentation](https://tanstack.com/form/latest/docs/framework/react/guides/dynamic-validation).\n\n### Build the form\n\nWe can now build the form using the `form.Field` component from TanStack Form and the `\u003cField /\u003e` component.\n\n\u003cComponentSource\n  src="/registry/new-york-v4/examples/form-tanstack-demo.tsx"\n  title="form.tsx"\n/\u003e\n\n### Done\n\nThat's it. You now have a fully accessible form with client-side validation.\n\nWhen you submit the form, the `onSubmit` function will be called with the validated form data. If the form data is invalid, TanStack Form will display the errors next to each field.\n\n## Validation\n\n### Client-side Validation\n\nTanStack Form validates your form data using the Zod schema. Validation happens in real-time as the user types.\n\n`tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\" {13-15}\nimport { useForm } from \"@tanstack/react-form\"\n\nconst formSchema = z.object({\n  // ...\n})\n\nexport function BugReportForm() {\n  const form = useForm({\n    defaultValues: {\n      title: \"\",\n      description: \"\",\n    },\n    validators: {\n      onSubmit: formSchema,\n    },\n    onSubmit: async ({ value }) =\u003e {\n      console.log(value)\n    },\n  })\n\n  return \u003cform onSubmit={/* ... */}\u003e{/* ... */}\u003c/form\u003e\n}\n`\n\n### Validation Modes\n\nTanStack Form supports different validation strategies through the `validators` option:\n\n| Mode         | Description                          |\n| ------------ | ------------------------------------ |\n| `\"onChange\"` | Validation triggers on every change. |\n| `\"onBlur\"`   | Validation triggers on blur.         |\n| `\"onSubmit\"` | Validation triggers on submit.       |\n\n`tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\" {6-9}\nconst form = useForm({\n  defaultValues: {\n    title: \"\",\n    description: \"\",\n  },\n  validators: {\n    onSubmit: formSchema,\n    onChange: formSchema,\n    onBlur: formSchema,\n  },\n})\n`\n\n## Displaying Errors\n\nDisplay errors next to the field using `\u003cFieldError /\u003e`. For styling and accessibility:\n\n- Add the `data-invalid` prop to the `\u003cField /\u003e` component.\n- Add the `aria-invalid` prop to the form control such as `\u003cInput /\u003e`, `\u003cSelectTrigger /\u003e`, `\u003cCheckbox /\u003e`, etc.\n\n`tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\" {4,18}\n\u003cform.Field\n  name=\"email\"\n  children={(field) =\u003e {\n    const isInvalid = field.state.meta.isTouched \u0026\u0026 !field.state.meta.isValid\n\n    return (\n      \u003cField data-invalid={isInvalid}\u003e\n        \u003cFieldLabel htmlFor={field.name}\u003eEmail\u003c/FieldLabel\u003e\n        \u003cInput\n          id={field.name}\n          name={field.name}\n          value={field.state.value}\n          onBlur={field.handleBlur}\n          onChange={(e) =\u003e field.handleChange(e.target.value)}\n          type=\"email\"\n          aria-invalid={isInvalid}\n        /\u003e\n        {isInvalid \u0026\u0026 \u003cFieldError errors={field.state.meta.errors} /\u003e}\n      \u003c/Field\u003e\n    )\n  }}\n/\u003e\n`\n\n## Working with Different Field Types\n\n### Input\n\n- For input fields, use `field.state.value` and `field.handleChange` on the `\u003cInput /\u003e` component.\n- To show errors, add the `aria-invalid` prop to the `\u003cInput /\u003e` component and the `data-invalid` prop to the `\u003cField /\u003e` component.\n\n\u003cComponentPreview\n  name="form-tanstack-input"\n  className="sm:\[\u0026*.preview]:h-\[700px]"\n  chromeLessOnMobile\n/\u003e\n\n`tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\" {6,11-14,22}\n\u003cform.Field\n  name=\"username\"\n  children={(field) =\u003e {\n    const isInvalid = field.state.meta.isTouched \u0026\u0026 !field.state.meta.isValid\n    return (\n      \u003cField data-invalid={isInvalid}\u003e\n        \u003cFieldLabel htmlFor=\"form-tanstack-input-username\"\u003eUsername\u003c/FieldLabel\u003e\n        \u003cInput\n          id=\"form-tanstack-input-username\"\n          name={field.name}\n          value={field.state.value}\n          onBlur={field.handleBlur}\n          onChange={(e) =\u003e field.handleChange(e.target.value)}\n          aria-invalid={isInvalid}\n          placeholder=\"shadcn\"\n          autoComplete=\"username\"\n        /\u003e\n        \u003cFieldDescription\u003e\n          This is your public display name. Must be between 3 and 10 characters.\n          Must only contain letters, numbers, and underscores.\n        \u003c/FieldDescription\u003e\n        {isInvalid \u0026\u0026 \u003cFieldError errors={field.state.meta.errors} /\u003e}\n      \u003c/Field\u003e\n    )\n  }}\n/\u003e\n`\n\n### Textarea\n\n- For textarea fields, use `field.state.value` and `field.handleChange` on the `\u003cTextarea /\u003e` component.\n- To show errors, add the `aria-invalid` prop to the `\u003cTextarea /\u003e` component and the `data-invalid` prop to the `\u003cField /\u003e` component.\n\n\u003cComponentPreview\n  name="form-tanstack-textarea"\n  className="sm:\[\u0026*.preview]:h-\[700px]"\n  chromeLessOnMobile\n/\u003e\n\n`tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\" {6,13-16,24}\n\u003cform.Field\n  name=\"about\"\n  children={(field) =\u003e {\n    const isInvalid = field.state.meta.isTouched \u0026\u0026 !field.state.meta.isValid\n    return (\n      \u003cField data-invalid={isInvalid}\u003e\n        \u003cFieldLabel htmlFor=\"form-tanstack-textarea-about\"\u003e\n          More about you\n        \u003c/FieldLabel\u003e\n        \u003cTextarea\n          id=\"form-tanstack-textarea-about\"\n          name={field.name}\n          value={field.state.value}\n          onBlur={field.handleBlur}\n          onChange={(e) =\u003e field.handleChange(e.target.value)}\n          aria-invalid={isInvalid}\n          placeholder=\"I'm a software engineer...\"\n          className=\"min-h-[120px]\"\n        /\u003e\n        \u003cFieldDescription\u003e\n          Tell us more about yourself. This will be used to help us personalize\n          your experience.\n        \u003c/FieldDescription\u003e\n        {isInvalid \u0026\u0026 \u003cFieldError errors={field.state.meta.errors} /\u003e}\n      \u003c/Field\u003e\n    )\n  }}\n/\u003e\n`\n\n### Select\n\n- For select components, use `field.state.value` and `field.handleChange` on the `\u003cSelect /\u003e` component.\n- To show errors, add the `aria-invalid` prop to the `\u003cSelectTrigger /\u003e` component and the `data-invalid` prop to the `\u003cField /\u003e` component.\n\n\u003cComponentPreview\n  name="form-tanstack-select"\n  className="sm:\[\u0026*.preview]:h-\[700px]"\n  chromeLessOnMobile\n/\u003e\n\n`tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\" {6,18-19,23}\n\u003cform.Field\n  name=\"language\"\n  children={(field) =\u003e {\n    const isInvalid = field.state.meta.isTouched \u0026\u0026 !field.state.meta.isValid\n    return (\n      \u003cField orientation=\"responsive\" data-invalid={isInvalid}\u003e\n        \u003cFieldContent\u003e\n          \u003cFieldLabel htmlFor=\"form-tanstack-select-language\"\u003e\n            Spoken Language\n          \u003c/FieldLabel\u003e\n          \u003cFieldDescription\u003e\n            For best results, select the language you speak.\n          \u003c/FieldDescription\u003e\n          {isInvalid \u0026\u0026 \u003cFieldError errors={field.state.meta.errors} /\u003e}\n        \u003c/FieldContent\u003e\n        \u003cSelect\n          name={field.name}\n          value={field.state.value}\n          onValueChange={field.handleChange}\n        \u003e\n          \u003cSelectTrigger\n            id=\"form-tanstack-select-language\"\n            aria-invalid={isInvalid}\n            className=\"min-w-[120px]\"\n          \u003e\n            \u003cSelectValue placeholder=\"Select\" /\u003e\n          \u003c/SelectTrigger\u003e\n          \u003cSelectContent position=\"item-aligned\"\u003e\n            \u003cSelectItem value=\"auto\"\u003eAuto\u003c/SelectItem\u003e\n            \u003cSelectItem value=\"en\"\u003eEnglish\u003c/SelectItem\u003e\n          \u003c/SelectContent\u003e\n        \u003c/Select\u003e\n      \u003c/Field\u003e\n    )\n  }}\n/\u003e\n`\n\n### Checkbox\n\n- For checkbox, use `field.state.value` and `field.handleChange` on the `\u003cCheckbox /\u003e` component.\n- To show errors, add the `aria-invalid` prop to the `\u003cCheckbox /\u003e` component and the `data-invalid` prop to the `\u003cField /\u003e` component.\n- For checkbox arrays, use `mode=\"array\"` on the `\u003cform.Field /\u003e` component and TanStack Form's array helpers.\n- Remember to add `data-slot=\"checkbox-group\"` to the `\u003cFieldGroup /\u003e` component for proper styling and spacing.\n\n\u003cComponentPreview\n  name="form-tanstack-checkbox"\n  className="sm:\[\u0026*.preview]:h-\[700px]"\n  chromeLessOnMobile\n/\u003e\n\n``tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\" {12,17,22-24,44}\n\u003cform.Field\n  name=\"tasks\"\n  mode=\"array\"\n  children={(field) =\u003e {\n    const isInvalid = field.state.meta.isTouched \u0026\u0026 !field.state.meta.isValid\n    return (\n      \u003cFieldSet\u003e\n        \u003cFieldLegend variant=\"label\"\u003eTasks\u003c/FieldLegend\u003e\n        \u003cFieldDescription\u003e\n          Get notified when tasks you\u0026apos;ve created have updates.\n        \u003c/FieldDescription\u003e\n        \u003cFieldGroup data-slot=\"checkbox-group\"\u003e\n          {tasks.map((task) =\u003e (\n            \u003cField\n              key={task.id}\n              orientation=\"horizontal\"\n              data-invalid={isInvalid}\n            \u003e\n              \u003cCheckbox\n                id={`form-tanstack-checkbox-${task.id}`}\n                name={field.name}\n                aria-invalid={isInvalid}\n                checked={field.state.value.includes(task.id)}\n                onCheckedChange={(checked) =\u003e {\n                  if (checked) {\n                    field.pushValue(task.id)\n                  } else {\n                    const index = field.state.value.indexOf(task.id)\n                    if (index \u003e -1) {\n                      field.removeValue(index)\n                    }\n                  }\n                }}\n              /\u003e\n              \u003cFieldLabel\n                htmlFor={`form-tanstack-checkbox-${task.id}`}\n                className=\"font-normal\"\n              \u003e\n                {task.label}\n              \u003c/FieldLabel\u003e\n            \u003c/Field\u003e\n          ))}\n        \u003c/FieldGroup\u003e\n        {isInvalid \u0026\u0026 \u003cFieldError errors={field.state.meta.errors} /\u003e}\n      \u003c/FieldSet\u003e\n    )\n  }}\n/\u003e\n``\n\n### Radio Group\n\n- For radio groups, use `field.state.value` and `field.handleChange` on the `\u003cRadioGroup /\u003e` component.\n- To show errors, add the `aria-invalid` prop to the `\u003cRadioGroupItem /\u003e` component and the `data-invalid` prop to the `\u003cField /\u003e` component.\n\n\u003cComponentPreview\n  name="form-tanstack-radiogroup"\n  className="sm:\[\u0026*.preview]:h-\[700px]"\n  chromeLessOnMobile\n/\u003e\n\n``tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\" {21,29,35}\n\u003cform.Field\n  name=\"plan\"\n  children={(field) =\u003e {\n    const isInvalid = field.state.meta.isTouched \u0026\u0026 !field.state.meta.isValid\n    return (\n      \u003cFieldSet\u003e\n        \u003cFieldLegend\u003ePlan\u003c/FieldLegend\u003e\n        \u003cFieldDescription\u003e\n          You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time.\n        \u003c/FieldDescription\u003e\n        \u003cRadioGroup\n          name={field.name}\n          value={field.state.value}\n          onValueChange={field.handleChange}\n        \u003e\n          {plans.map((plan) =\u003e (\n            \u003cFieldLabel\n              key={plan.id}\n              htmlFor={`form-tanstack-radiogroup-${plan.id}`}\n            \u003e\n              \u003cField orientation=\"horizontal\" data-invalid={isInvalid}\u003e\n                \u003cFieldContent\u003e\n                  \u003cFieldTitle\u003e{plan.title}\u003c/FieldTitle\u003e\n                  \u003cFieldDescription\u003e{plan.description}\u003c/FieldDescription\u003e\n                \u003c/FieldContent\u003e\n                \u003cRadioGroupItem\n                  value={plan.id}\n                  id={`form-tanstack-radiogroup-${plan.id}`}\n                  aria-invalid={isInvalid}\n                /\u003e\n              \u003c/Field\u003e\n            \u003c/FieldLabel\u003e\n          ))}\n        \u003c/RadioGroup\u003e\n        {isInvalid \u0026\u0026 \u003cFieldError errors={field.state.meta.errors} /\u003e}\n      \u003c/FieldSet\u003e\n    )\n  }}\n/\u003e\n``\n\n### Switch\n\n- For switches, use `field.state.value` and `field.handleChange` on the `\u003cSwitch /\u003e` component.\n- To show errors, add the `aria-invalid` prop to the `\u003cSwitch /\u003e` component and the `data-invalid` prop to the `\u003cField /\u003e` component.\n\n\u003cComponentPreview\n  name="form-tanstack-switch"\n  className="sm:\[\u0026*.preview]:h-\[500px]"\n  chromeLessOnMobile\n/\u003e\n\n`tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\" {6,14,19-21}\n\u003cform.Field\n  name=\"twoFactor\"\n  children={(field) =\u003e {\n    const isInvalid = field.state.meta.isTouched \u0026\u0026 !field.state.meta.isValid\n    return (\n      \u003cField orientation=\"horizontal\" data-invalid={isInvalid}\u003e\n        \u003cFieldContent\u003e\n          \u003cFieldLabel htmlFor=\"form-tanstack-switch-twoFactor\"\u003e\n            Multi-factor authentication\n          \u003c/FieldLabel\u003e\n          \u003cFieldDescription\u003e\n            Enable multi-factor authentication to secure your account.\n          \u003c/FieldDescription\u003e\n          {isInvalid \u0026\u0026 \u003cFieldError errors={field.state.meta.errors} /\u003e}\n        \u003c/FieldContent\u003e\n        \u003cSwitch\n          id=\"form-tanstack-switch-twoFactor\"\n          name={field.name}\n          checked={field.state.value}\n          onCheckedChange={field.handleChange}\n          aria-invalid={isInvalid}\n        /\u003e\n      \u003c/Field\u003e\n    )\n  }}\n/\u003e\n`\n\n### Complex Forms\n\nHere is an example of a more complex form with multiple fields and validation.\n\n\u003cComponentPreview\n  name="form-tanstack-complex"\n  className="sm:\[\u0026*.preview]:h-\[1100px]"\n  chromeLessOnMobile\n/\u003e\n\n## Resetting the Form\n\nUse `form.reset()` to reset the form to its default values.\n\n`tsx showLineNumbers\n\u003cButton type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" onClick={() =\u003e form.reset()}\u003e\n  Reset\n\u003c/Button\u003e\n`\n\n## Array Fields\n\nTanStack Form provides powerful array field management with `mode=\"array\"`. This allows you to dynamically add, remove, and update array items with full validation support.\n\n\u003cComponentPreview\n  name="form-tanstack-array"\n  className="sm:\[\u0026*.preview]:h-\[700px]"\n  chromeLessOnMobile\n/\u003e\n\nThis example demonstrates managing multiple email addresses with array fields. Users can add up to 5 email addresses, remove individual addresses, and each address is validated independently.\n\n### Array Field Structure\n\nUse `mode=\"array\"` on the parent field to enable array field management.\n\n`tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\" {3,12-14}\n\u003cform.Field\n  name=\"emails\"\n  mode=\"array\"\n  children={(field) =\u003e {\n    return (\n      \u003cFieldSet\u003e\n        \u003cFieldLegend variant=\"label\"\u003eEmail Addresses\u003c/FieldLegend\u003e\n        \u003cFieldDescription\u003e\n          Add up to 5 email addresses where we can contact you.\n        \u003c/FieldDescription\u003e\n        \u003cFieldGroup\u003e\n          {field.state.value.map((_, index) =\u003e (\n            // Nested field for each array item\n          ))}\n        \u003c/FieldGroup\u003e\n      \u003c/FieldSet\u003e\n    )\n  }}\n/\u003e\n`\n\n### Nested Fields\n\nAccess individual array items using bracket notation: `fieldName[index].propertyName`. This example uses `InputGroup` to display the remove button inline with the input.\n\n``tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\"\n\u003cform.Field\n  name={`emails[${index}].address`}\n  children={(subField) =\u003e {\n    const isSubFieldInvalid =\n      subField.state.meta.isTouched \u0026\u0026 !subField.state.meta.isValid\n    return (\n      \u003cField orientation=\"horizontal\" data-invalid={isSubFieldInvalid}\u003e\n        \u003cFieldContent\u003e\n          \u003cInputGroup\u003e\n            \u003cInputGroupInput\n              id={`form-tanstack-array-email-${index}`}\n              name={subField.name}\n              value={subField.state.value}\n              onBlur={subField.handleBlur}\n              onChange={(e) =\u003e subField.handleChange(e.target.value)}\n              aria-invalid={isSubFieldInvalid}\n              placeholder=\"name@example.com\"\n              type=\"email\"\n            /\u003e\n            {field.state.value.length \u003e 1 \u0026\u0026 (\n              \u003cInputGroupAddon align=\"inline-end\"\u003e\n                \u003cInputGroupButton\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  variant=\"ghost\"\n                  size=\"icon-xs\"\n                  onClick={() =\u003e field.removeValue(index)}\n                  aria-label={`Remove email ${index + 1}`}\n                \u003e\n                  \u003cXIcon /\u003e\n                \u003c/InputGroupButton\u003e\n              \u003c/InputGroupAddon\u003e\n            )}\n          \u003c/InputGroup\u003e\n          {isSubFieldInvalid \u0026\u0026 (\n            \u003cFieldError errors={subField.state.meta.errors} /\u003e\n          )}\n        \u003c/FieldContent\u003e\n      \u003c/Field\u003e\n    )\n  }}\n/\u003e\n``\n\n### Adding Items\n\nUse `field.pushValue(item)` to add items to an array field. You can disable the button when the array reaches its maximum length.\n\n`tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\"\n\u003cButton\n  type=\"button\"\n  variant=\"outline\"\n  size=\"sm\"\n  onClick={() =\u003e field.pushValue({ address: \"\" })}\n  disabled={field.state.value.length \u003e= 5}\n\u003e\n  Add Email Address\n\u003c/Button\u003e\n`\n\n### Removing Items\n\nUse `field.removeValue(index)` to remove items from an array field. You can conditionally show the remove button only when there's more than one item.\n\n``tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\"\n{\n  field.state.value.length \u003e 1 \u0026\u0026 (\n    \u003cInputGroupButton\n      onClick={() =\u003e field.removeValue(index)}\n      aria-label={`Remove email ${index + 1}`}\n    \u003e\n      \u003cXIcon /\u003e\n    \u003c/InputGroupButton\u003e\n  )\n}\n``\n\n### Array Validation\n\nValidate array fields using Zod's array methods.\n\n`tsx showLineNumbers title=\"form.tsx\"\nconst formSchema = z.object({\n  emails: z\n    .array(\n      z.object({\n        address: z.string().email(\"Enter a valid email address.\"),\n      })\n    )\n    .min(1, \"Add at least one email address.\")\n    .max(5, \"You can add up to 5 email addresses.\"),\n})\n`\n"])</script><script>self.\_\_next\_f.push(\[1,"1f:\["$","div",null,{"data-slot":"docs","className":"flex scroll-mt-24 items-stretch pb-8 text-\[1.05rem] sm:text-\[15px]
